craft_notes: Sthāyin: exemption. Sanskrit-first: triple locative kept. Rows: 2. Close: them. Rejected: merging exempt and bound — killed: the split is the verse. Read aloud: parting cadence.

lines: Free souls walk past; the bound are weighed and won.
l4.sanskrit_cite: avadhūte nirācāre tattvajñe natvayaṃ vidhiḥ | sācāraiḥ kriyate dīkṣā yā dṛṣṭapratyayānvitā
